notes.title: update to car car crash
notes.content:
This build has three big changes:

New save file 
(so you're starting over if you played before)

New rotate road mechanic.
To rotate road you press and hold the GRIP button on your Vive controllers   Which was necessitated by the next change…

Create Your Own road layouts!   

You should see three “blank” game mats on the Buy Load playmats screen.  These three mats come with the Dispense-O-Matic from which you can pick roads, buildings and other “special” blocks that you can place on your mat to make your own adventure.  The special blocks are really exciting and allow you to do fun and interesting things with your cars.  Try them out, experiment and play.  

I promise there are plenty of bugs in this build, particularly with building your own roads, but I have been having too much fun with this feature to keep it from you any longer. 
The save button is on the BACK of the dispense-o-matic.  Loading and saving “mostly” work.  Saving is NOT automatic.

notes.title: COMING SOON: Make Your Own Route!
notes.content:
FYI:  Im working on a system for building your own routes.

You will start with an empty play mat.  
You can reach over and grab stuff from the "Dispense-O-Matic" 
You can lay down your own route and start your own little adventure.  
There will be jumps

notes.title: Which feature I should work on next?
notes.content:
Hi Car Car Crashers!  I have some free time this weekend to work on “Car Car Crash.”  Aside from bug fixes, which one of the changes below would you like to see implemented in Car Car Crash first?

[list]
[*]A new playmat!
   Create a new playmat with several challenging checkpoints 
[*]Placeable Jumps!
   A “toy” you can place anywhere on the playmat and have the cars “jump” over a section of road.  
[*]UFO attack
   A “flying saucer” toy that comes to life, buzzing around and zapping cars!
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Car Car Crash
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of issues:

[list]
[*]Exploding cars are not worth any points.  This nullifies the exploit where spamming cars in the garage will earn you quick cash.

[*]Prevent loading the "buy Play mats" menu during play for money game

[*]Freeze time reduced to 5 seconds

[*]Re-balanced time and car limits for most play mats.  

[*]Re-priced play mats based on potential earning power.
[/list]

This update should not change your current stats\progression.  
...but..If you WANT to start over remove the playerInfo.dat file in:

...\AppData\LocalLow\Choclatefudge Games\CarCarCrash VIVE EDITION
